description: Shorti(쇼티) for a TikTok, Reels or Shorts link with «how was this shot?», «이 영상 어떻게 찍었어?», «나도 이렇게 찍으려면?», «내 버전으로» or «분석해줘». One video's move, who else made it, then how to shoot their version. `url` or `video_id`: its move, who else (not_in_corpus: not read). `part` plan: its steps, what to keep or change; flow (how it moved; `lineage`); scene (where the phone stood). `format_id`: plan and hits.
